mapper.select: select s.id as scheduleId, c.id as classId, c.class_period as classPeriod, c.campus_id as campusId, ca.campus_location as campusName, s.class_type as classType, s.course_content as courseContent, duty.teacher_id as teacherId, coalesce(nullif(u.real_name, ''), nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as teacherName from sys_class_schedule s inner join sys_class c on c.id = s.class_id inner join sys_campus ca on ca.id = c.campus_id left join sys_class_duty duty on duty.id = ( select max(d1.id) from sys_class_duty d1 where d1.class_id = c.id and d1.duty_date = #{dutyDate} and d1.duty_type = case when s.class_type = 'CLASS' then 'EVENING_STUDY_CLASS' else 'SELF_STUDY_CLASS' end ) left join sys_user u on u.id = duty.teacher_id where s.schedule_date = #{dutyDate} and s.class_type in ('CLASS', 'SELF_STUDY') order by ca.id, c.id

select distinct ca.id as campusId, ca.campus_location as campusName, duty.teacher_id as teacherId, coalesce(nullif(u.real_name, ''), nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as teacherName from sys_class_schedule s inner join sys_class c on c.id = s.class_id inner join sys_campus ca on ca.id = c.campus_id left join sys_class_duty duty on duty.id = ( select max(d1.id) from sys_class_duty d1 where d1.class_id is null and d1.campus_id = ca.id and d1.duty_date = #{dutyDate} and d1.duty_type = 'EVENING_STUDY_CAMPUS' ) left join sys_user u on u.id = duty.teacher_id where s.schedule_date = #{dutyDate} and s.class_type = 'CLASS' order by ca.id

select count(distinct u.id) from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id inner join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where u.id = #{teacherId} and u.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.role_code = 'TEACHER'
select count(*) from sys_class_schedule s inner join sys_class c on c.id = s.class_id where c.campus_id = #{campusId} and s.schedule_date = #{dutyDate} and s.class_type = 'CLASS'
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_class_duty (class_id, campus_id, teacher_id, duty_date, duty_type, start_time, end_time, remark, created_at, updated_at) values
(#{item.classId}, #{item.campusId}, #{item.teacherId}, #{item.dutyDate}, #{item.dutyType}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime}, #{item.remark}, now(), now())
